feeds.title: The Italian Dog Blog
feeds.description: The Italian Dog Blog is a blog about dogs. The blog covers a variety of topics related to dogs, such as pet-friendly travel, dog food, and dog accessories. Maria Cavallo is passionate about communication and social media, in 2011 she decided to share her daily life online with Louis , creating The Italian Dog Blog , the first dog-blog in Italy. Read product reviews, diaries, useful information on how to become a dog influencer, training, veterinary experiences, and much more.

feeds.title: Dog Fashion Blogger
feeds.description: The first Italian blog magazine on 4-legged Fashion and Lifestyle. On the site ,you will find information on new trends: clothing, accessories, and advice on books to read at the weekend. Interviews with VIPs with their 4-legged friends in collaboration with Radio Bau, charity events and more.

feeds.title: Dog Heroes Blog
feeds.description: DogHeroes is a website that delivers fresh, healthy food for dogs to your door. You can create a custom meal plan for your dog based on their age, breed, and activity level. DogHeroes uses only human-grade ingredients, and their food is free of artificial colors, flavors, and preservatives.

feeds.title: Robinson Pet Blog » Dog
feeds.description: Robinson Pet Shop is an online pet shop that sells a wide variety of products for dogs and cats, including food, toys, beds, and accessories. They also offer a range of services, such as delivery and vet consultations. This is a dedicated section where you can find useful tips related to nutrition, reading keys to learning to know the dog's language or the reasons behind some behaviors and also insights on to protect their health.

feeds.title: Petme » Dogs
feeds.description: PetMe Srl, a company part of the Ebano SpA holding is the owner of the petme.it portal, dedicated to pet lovers and their owners. Petme.it, hanks to an editorial staff made up of professional journalists, offers the best and most updated information on the world of pets and more every day, enriched by podcasts and videos for an immersive and engaging experience, in a contemporary graphic design. simple and clean.

feeds.title: Smart Dog Blog
feeds.description: Smart Dog is an Italian brand of pet products that focuses on the well-being of dogs and cats. The company was founded by Eleonora Mentaschi, a professional ethologist and behaviorist, who believes that all products should respect the animal's needs and improve their quality of life. Smart Dog products are designed by experts and made from high-quality, sustainable materials.

feeds.description: Explore luxury dog beds and accessories, made in Italy. Unique elegance and comfort. Free shipping on orders over €100. Discover more!
